title: Project native instructions
moment: Native project instruction load before action; native hierarchy rules vary by harness
current: Project AGENTS.md managed region is installed once; project-owned text remains outside it. The managed region opens with the field-note directive, so every installed session receives it. Claude also gets .claude/rules/session.md, which only names the long-command watch pair and points to the Long commands and waits section of .yoke/docs/agents/claude.md; hook, session-end and Monitor-park recovery live in its Hooks and session recovery section and in the refusals themselves. Agent judgment lives in one file, .yoke/docs/agents/rules.md; each command's --help ends with its recipe and each refusal names its reason and fix. The managed region's Operation homes section now holds only the Live recipes line and a pointer to that rules file. Codex/Cursor use AGENTS.md. The Yoke repository adds only a two-line pointer to docs/source-dev-doctrine.md outside the managed region. Native discovery has minimum engines and configuration conditions.
planned: JOURNEYS keeps static project guidance in AGENTS/rules.
